question: Per risk appetite, give the average number of holdings per investor, the average total transaction size per investor, and the average risk rating.
sql_query: WITH a AS (SELECT investor_id, COUNT(*) AS v FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 GROUP BY investor_id), b AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS v FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance, ROUND(AVG(a.v),2) AS avg_holdings, ROUND(AVG(b.v),2) AS avg_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

sql_query: WITH a AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) AS v FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id), b AS (SELECT o.investor_id, AVG(o.returns_pct) AS v FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o WHERE o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.investor_id) SELECT p.segment AS segment, ROUND(AVG(a.v),2) AS avg_allocation, ROUND(AVG(b.v),2) AS avg_holding_return, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.segment ORDER BY p.segment;
